description: Encrypt a message with a password: AES-256-GCM, key from PBKDF2-SHA256 (600,000 rounds, random 16-byte salt, 12-byte IV), output as one "S3E1.…" base64 line. Exactly the website's format, so the result can be decrypted at https://s3eidat.github.io/text-encrypt/ or with crypto_text_decrypt. Each run gives a different output. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/text-encrypt/

output.description: Optional: also save the encrypted line to this file (website "Save" gives encrypted.txt).

password.description: The password. Normalised to Unicode NFC first, like the website.

path.description: Or: a UTF-8 text file to encrypt.

name: crypto_text_encrypt
title: Encrypt text (AES-256-GCM)
